title: Linked Vanilla Chests
description: Makes using vanilla wooden chests a lot easier by linking chests that are placed next to each other. Linked chests can be searched together with a search bar and easily switched in between. Only adds UI to vanilla wooden chests, no new blocks.
body:
# Linked Vanilla Chests

Tired of searching through all your chests manually? Or spending hours on a huge sorrting system?

Linked Vanilla Chests makes large vanilla storage systems much easier to use while staying true to the vanilla experience.

Chests or barrels placed next to each other in any direction automatically link together.
Open any connected chest or barrel and switch between nearby storage blocks without closing and reopening inventories. The search bar lets you quickly find items across the entire connected storage network.

## Features

* Navigate between connected chests and barrels using arrow buttons.
  ![GIF of switch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c3b94bb400ff1502daf517b0e36953d0d7674d8.gif)
* Search for items across all connected storage.
  ![GIF of search](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/821223c90dcc109a2983dcf4e0ef54854fc4af9d.gif)
* Easy sorting: Middle mouse click on an item to auto search your chests for it.
  ![GIF of autosearch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6597ec705bf6851a1162a28b7586f62a8041786d.gif)
* Supports single chests, double chests, and barrels.
* Connected storage works horizontally and vertically.
* Uses the normal vanilla chest interface — adds no custom blocks or inventories.
